escenas.texto: This week in Africa, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and thirty-one million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted six days ago. Over nine hundred and seventy-two thousand views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Next up, number nine, 𝗟𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗟𝗼𝗱𝘀, with “Spider-Man 2 LIVE Chat Decides Everything!”. Over one point two million views. A video over sixty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has two comments.

At number eight, from Tunisia, ZARUFA FF, with a video posted four days ago. Over one point four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A video over one hundred and twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Number seven, Itelediconstudio, with a video posted four days ago. Over six point two million views. A video over eighty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over ten thousand comments.
Number six, Saqib Saifi, with a video posted four days ago. Over eleven million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

At number five, Greg Batocabe, with “bros hair is a whip”. Over eleven million views. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eighteen seconds.
In position number four, from Egypt, Omar kotb, with a video posted five days ago. Over eleven million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has fifty-four comments.
Bronze medal, Sam Family, with “Dada Has a Girlfriend! Baby Sam Wants 20 to Talk”. Over thirteen million views. A Short of just thirty-one seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.
Silver medal, Calm man , with “The fight between the two couples.”. Over twenty-one million views. It also has one hundred and forty-one comments.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, Silly AI Lab, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-one million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and ten thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Coming in at number ten, Saqib Saifi, with a video posted four days ago. Over one thousand comments. It also has over eleven million views.

In position number nine, from Egypt, MessiGaming10, with a video posted five days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four hundred and sixty-one thousand views.
At number eight, DLT, with a video posted two days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over seventy-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Number seven, from Egypt, Moham OverKill, with a video posted two days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over twenty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Next up, number six, MAXWELL MWALIMU Official, with a video posted five days ago. Over two thousand comments. It also has over two hundred and eighty-five thousand views.

In position number five, from South Africa, kell kay, with “Kell Kay x Yo Maps x Temwah - Don’t Call Official Music Video”. Over two thousand comments. It also has over seven hundred and ninety thousand views.

Coming in at number four, Greg Batocabe, with “bros hair is a whip”. Over two thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and thirty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
Bronze medal, More Techy, with “Roblox 1 titan evolution...”. Over three thousand comments. It also has over six hundred and nineteen thousand views.

Silver medal, from Egypt, JIGGSo_ar, with a video posted six days ago. Over eight thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: twelve out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-six minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, Itelediconstudio, with a video posted four days ago. Over ten thousand comments. A video over eighty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over six point two million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from South Africa, kell kay, with “Kell Kay x Yo Maps x Temwah - Don’t Call Official Music Video”. Over twenty-four thousand likes. It also has over seven hundred and ninety thousand views.

At number nine, from Egypt, MessiGaming10, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty-five thousand likes. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four hundred and sixty-one thousand views.

At number eight, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted four days ago. Over forty-four thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over thirty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Coming in at number seven, from Egypt, Omar kotb, with a video posted five days ago. Over fifty-one thousand likes. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has over eleven million views.

In position number six, Itelediconstudio, with a video posted four days ago. Over ninety-one thousand likes. A video over eighty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over six point two million views.

In position number five, Silly AI Lab, with a video posted four days ago. Over one hundred and eleven thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and ten thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Next up, number four, Sam Family, with “Dada Has a Girlfriend! Baby Sam Wants 20 to Talk”. Over one hundred and sixty-seven thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-one seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.
Bronze medal, Calm man , with “The fight between the two couples.”. Over two hundred and three thousand likes. It also has over twenty-one million views.
Silver medal, Saqib Saifi, with a video posted four days ago. Over two hundred and fifty-four thousand likes. It also has over eleven million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most liked, Greg Batocabe, with “bros hair is a whip”. Over two hundred and eighty-one thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eighteen seconds.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Europe. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Africa every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
